description: Locked WordPress-to-Blogger 1:1 MASTER MAP. WordPress remains unchanged. Blogger shells are separate editorial properties and never copy WordPress posts.
seo_setup_note: Blogger API v3 exposes the Blogs resource as read-only (get/list only) — blog-level Description and Search preferences cannot be set via API. The description/search_description values below must be pasted manually into Blogger: Settings > Basic > Description, and Settings > Search preferences > Meta tags > Description. koreamedicaltour.com (order 7) uses koreamedicaltour365.blogspot.com, matching the pairing already wired in config/automation_hub_sites.json's blogger_koreamedicaltour365 entry.
seo_checklist_per_blog: Settings > Basic > Privacy > 'Let search engines find your blog': ON (critical — off means it never gets indexed)
Settings > Search preferences > Meta tags > Enable search description: YES, paste `search_description`
Settings > Search preferences > Errors and redirects: leave default unless a custom 404 is needed
Register the blog in Google Search Console and submit the sitemap: /sitemap.xml
First post: use the site's core keyword as a Label so Blogger's label archive helps indexing
Pages required: About, Contact, Privacy Policy, Disclaimer (per creation_policy)
